bio: Here, on the southern shore of Wörthersee, you could almost fancy yourself in the South Pacific. This beach restaurant enjoys a gorgeous lakeside location, where the reeds sway to the beat of the trendy background music. Relaxed bistro atmosphere, friendly down-to-earth service and good food including regional classics such as house-made Carinthian Kasnudeln (cheese dumplings) and Mediterranean specialities like freshly made pasta or fish dishes. How about a nice cocktail to top it off?...
